intro: The Premium Coffer Key Lock offers a compact, secure, and affordable way to safeguard your valuables. Its sleek, refined design blends effortlessly with any home décor, delivering both style and dependable protection.

features.title: Godrej Make Ultra Key Lock
features.text: Built for convenience and safety, the Godrej Key Lock uses secure, non-duplicable dimple keys, ensuring unmatched safety for your valuables. Its intuitive mechanism ensures smooth operation while delivering strong, reliable protection.

features.title: Ultimate Security with Twin Solid Steel Shooting Bolts
features.text: Our Home Locker is equipped with twin solid steel shooting bolts for enhanced protection. These heavy-duty bolts provide reinforced security by firmly locking the safe door in place, ensuring your valuables are safeguarded against unauthorized access. Enjoy peace of mind knowing that our compact home locker offers robust, reliable defense for your most prized possessions.

features.title: Mounting & Grouting
features.text: Designed for ultimate protection,this feature allows you to securely mount or grout the safe to walls, floors, or shelves using robust anchor bolts. By firmly fastening the locker in place, it becomes significantly more resistant to tampering or unauthorized removal, providing an extra layer of security.

features.title: Tough Metal Build
features.text: Built for superior security, our compact home locker features a tough metal construction that offers unmatched strength and durability. Despite its small size, this sturdy locker provides a reliable and secure storage solution for your valuables, ensuring peace of mind.

features.title: Powder Coated Finish
features.text: The powder-coated finish provides a durable, smooth, and scratch-resistant surface that enhances the longevity and aesthetic appeal of the locker.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
name: Premium Coffer V1 Keylock Safe
